donald-trump.label: Donald Trump
donald-trump.summary: speaking poses, office scenes, sports, seasonal activities and costume cartoons
donald-trump.lead: Donald Trump illustrations, from speaking poses to imagined costume scenes.
donald-trump.intro: Browse detailed color cutouts and black-and-white line drawings of Donald Trump. The scenes include microphones, office desks, golf, holidays and fictional roles such as astronaut, pirate and magician. Several also depict Melania Trump.
donald-trump.note: These are imagined illustrations and caricatures, not photographs or records of real events. Props, slogans and costumes are described as shown; their inclusion does not imply official endorsement. The colored US map is a decorative presentation prop, not verified election data.
